ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: After A Very Special Christmas, I would try another holiday album right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Elvis: Ultimate Gospel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar pop and rock songs than a gospel collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Essential Kinks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my interest in classic rock and retrospective collections, especially after the Beatles and mid-'60s hits.
ItemID: NA; Title: Little Broken Hearts; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This is less immediately appealing than the familiar hits collections I have been choosing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Us And The Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize enough here to choose it over music closer to my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Soul Station; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Cheek to Cheek suggests some interest in jazz vocals, but that alone would not make me choose this album.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Hit Singles Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like singles collections, but without an artist or track list I cannot tell whether these are songs I want.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Essential Willie Nelson; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A career collection appeals in principle, but country is not what I am seeking this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of John Michael Montgomery; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent choices give me little reason to pick this country collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Carly Simon Reflections; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Carly Simon fits the melodic singer-songwriter listening reflected in my Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie choices.
